newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Alliance's Lee dominant in Auckland Central - poll.
newsitem.headline: Alliance's Lee dominant in Auckland Central - poll.

text.p: The Alliance Party's Sandra Lee is the preferred electorate candidate for her seat of Auckland Central, Television New Zealand said on Tuesday.

TVNZ said its latest One Network News Colmar Brunton poll showed that Lee led with 35 percent, followed by Labour's Judith Tizard on 30, National's Shane Frith with 18 and New Zealand First's Richard Whittacker on seven.
Among the minor parties, Act New Zealand's Rodney Hide was on 5.3 percent and the Christian Coalition's Barry Patterson on 3.1. TVNZ said 17 percent were undecided.
In the party vote, Labour and National were both on 28 percent, eight points ahead of the Alliance.
NZ First was on 11 percent and Act on nine but 13 percent of Auckland Central voters were undecided as to how they would cast their party vote.
Frith said National's own polling showed that it would win the party vote outright in Auckland Central at the October 12 election. -- Wellington Newsroom (64-4-4734746)
